product.name: Signups & Identity
product.description: Passwordless sign-in for any website (one-time codes by e-mail, SMS or WhatsApp through the merchant's own messaging, magic links), customer profiles, sessions as the website's own identity issuer (EdDSA JWTs + JWKS), account pages, risk checks, consent and self-service data rights — all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Customer profiles
elements.description: Customers and their profiles: the merchant's field schema, international addresses, custom fields and verification badges; server import and administration.

elements.name: Sessions & identity issuer
elements.description: Signups becomes the website's identity issuer: EdDSA access tokens any product verifies offline, a per-website JWKS with rotating keys, rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection, device list, revoke one or all.

elements.name: One-time codes
elements.description: Sign in with a code sent by e-mail, SMS or WhatsApp through the merchant's own messaging connector: hashed codes, atomic attempt budgets, cooldowns, per-identity / IP / website caps, uniform anti-enumeration answers.

elements.name: Magic links
elements.description: Sign in from a single-use e-mail link back to the website's own domain (hashed tokens, redirect allow-list, optional same-device binding).

elements.name: Account pages
elements.description: The signed-in customer's account: profile, addresses, devices and sessions, orders, consents and data requests — drop-in, headless or API.

elements.name: Sign-in widget
elements.description: Sign-in UI (modal or inline): identifier, code or link, consent, signed-in state; drop-in or headless, on the otp / magic_link API.

elements.name: Risk checks
elements.description: Disposable e-mail block list, new-device notices, velocity limits per IP (distinct identities, failed verifications) and a risk event log.

elements.name: Terms acceptance
elements.description: Versioned terms / privacy acceptance captured at sign-up and asked again when a required document changes.

elements.name: Data rights
elements.description: Self-service data export and account deletion with a cooling-off period.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Passwordless codes, profiles, sessions as the website's identity issuer, the sign-in widget and account pages.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything: codes and magic links, risk checks, consent capture and self-service data rights, higher limits.
